entries.description: Public MCP server for the Langfuse documentation: search the docs, fetch pages as Markdown, and get an overview of Langfuse. No authentication.
representativeQueries: how do I trace a LangGraph agent with Langfuse
how do Langfuse prompt management and versioning work
which Langfuse SDK version supports OpenTelemetry

entries.description: Authenticated MCP server for Langfuse project data: prompts, datasets, scores, observations, metrics, and more. HTTP Basic auth with a project API key pair; one endpoint per Cloud region.
representativeQueries: fetch the production version of my Langfuse prompt
list the latest failing traces in my Langfuse project
add items to a Langfuse dataset

entries.description: Agent skill for working with Langfuse: up-to-date documentation lookup, instrumentation and prompt management workflows, and API access through the Langfuse CLI. Install it before implementing anything with Langfuse.
representativeQueries: add Langfuse tracing to my application
migrate my prompts to Langfuse prompt management
query Langfuse traces from the command line

entries.description: OpenAPI description of the Langfuse public REST API (traces, observations, scores, prompts, datasets, experiments, metrics). HTTP Basic auth with a project API key pair; the project, membership, and API key management endpoints take an organization-scoped key pair instead.
Index of the Langfuse website for agents, with links to per-section indexes. Every page is also available as Markdown at its URL plus .md.
